incarnation: Nexus de Convergence — Elyra Null, current original selected atlas and Cell ZERO White Void dossier (2026)
sourceLimits: Originalprojectcharacter: retained atlas and individual dossier are internal authority, never a franchise-official external reference.

The old1024²atlas drawings are not perfectlycontainedwithin uniform256pixelcells: top-row firstfigurealpha runsy17–280. Inspection crops intentionally include288pxheight to retain boots, and do not claim to be exactruntimeframecrops. Root informed; sourcefile/runtimeunchanged bythisCGtask.
Specific violet forelock is anatomicalRIGHT from frontal reference. Exact iriscolor, motif microgeometry and covered angles remain source-resolution limited.
Equipment geometry/color is visible in atlas; tiny interior glyphs and authorization mechanics are interpreted with dossier limits rather than invented text.
All new environments are original coherent WhiteVoid/Nexus scenes, not copies of existing background assets.
Derivedcropextensions are previews of same internalatlas; never additional independent sources or a perfect1:1 approval.

slots.themeBrief: Référence entière d’Elyra Null courante, bobblanc à mècheviolette DROITE anatomique, tenue technique blanche/violette/noire sans transformation.
slots.poseBrief: Appui calme de trois quarts contre un pilier bas, coude gauche posé sur le rebord et main droite tenant une carte violette à hauteur de hanche; jambes séparées et regard vigilant.
